symptomReferences.symptom: left side of body is smaller

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Bearing-down sensation. Menses early,
profuse, prolonged, bright red. Sleepy. No desire for
anything. Fingers seem swollen. Uterine hemorrhages
caused by overlifting, during puerperal state; menor-
rhagia.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare : I pec.; SiL; Trill.

Antidote : Aeon.
